messages.author: 017566be30afa7f3
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] cut-points preschool
parts:
Hi Javier,

Cut-points derived from raw data accelerometry are mostly applicable across sensor brands. When there are multiple cut-points available for an age group I would recommend trying to use an average of multiple studies or to stick with the cut-point used in other studies you want to compare with.

Note that it is your responsibility as a research to choose the cut-points. We or GGIR cannot do that for you: The choice depends on your knowledge of your the study protocol, the study population, and the way you plan to interpret your results.

Best, Vincent
